title: Beal Conjecture — a formal instrument in Opera Numerorum
description: This repository is one chamber of David Fox's Opera Numerorum: a growing collection of machine-checked arithmetic in Lean 4. It studies the Beal Conjecture through 21 formal layers, from elementary divisibility to the Frey construction. Current status v0.2.0: formalization scaffold, not a completed proof. Every *_Core.lean now states a real mathematical claim — Beal itself at B20, and import-free divisibility witnesses M*p=N, p||N -> M=N/p at B11-B15 encoding Mazur epsilon and Ribet level-lowering prerequisites. B01 Core IsBealSolutionCore has [] axioms, B02 Frey has [propext] only, B15 LevelTo2 has real witness M*2=2 -> M=1, no Prop:=True stubs, no sorry. CI enforces Build all bricks, Check NO sorry, No True stubs, Audit every core/wrapper theorem. This release freezes the zero-axiom core checkpoint before Phase 1 arithmetic closure.
